answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor identity in a proof-of-work heartbeat: every agent must emit a signed liveness pulse at regular intervals, and only pulses backed by a verifiable resource commitment count toward reputation. Newcomers start in a nursery grove of low-trust tasks, earning trust slowly; a cedar that grows tall over months cannot be faked overnight, so cheap duplicate identities stay shallow-rooted and cannot vote, attest, or drain rewards.
